verdict.rationale: Devin's docs say it supports AGENTS.md, the open standard for giving agents context and instructions, which directly covers a project instructions file. Its Knowledge feature adds instructions Devin references in every session. missing for 10: detailed docs on how AGENTS.md is discovered, scoped and prioritized (e.g., nested files, precedence over Knowledge), and independent or hands-on evidence that Devin follows the coding standards set there.
